name: Tilion

modes.label: Managed browser service
modes.note: No CPU/RAM per session published. Two conflicting official figures: blog (2026-08-07) says '$0.03 per browser-hour' pay-per-use with free credits of 'a few hundred hours'; current pricing page shows subscription plans (Free/Developer $19.99/Pro $99.99/Scale $499) with included browser hours and 'Overage billed per hour' at an unpublished rate. Effective included-hour cost: Developer $0.20/h, Pro $0.20/h, Scale ~$0.10/h.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 10 browser h/mo, 500 MB egress/mo, 100 sessions/mo; hard stop at allowance (no overage).

plans.name: Developer
plans.note: 100 browser h/mo + 2 GB egress/mo included; unlimited sessions; overage billed per hour (rate unpublished).

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: 500 browser h/mo + 10 GB egress/mo included; unlimited sessions; overage billed per hour (rate unpublished).

plans.name: Scale
plans.note: 5,000 browser h/mo + 35 GB egress/mo included; unlimited sessions; overage billed per hour (rate unpublished).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: 250+ concurrent sessions, unlimited hours and egress, invoiced billing, engineer support channel. Price not published.

features.ip_note: Tilion Cloud (closed beta 2026-07-14, public/self-serve since 2026-08-07 per blog) advertises residential IP egress; plan egress allowances 500 MB (Free) to 35 GB/mo (Scale), Enterprise unlimited; no per-GB overage or residential price published; self-run Fortress engine uses whatever IP/proxy you bring.

caveats: Browser infrastructure: concurrency tiers and runtime-overage billing advertised; verify full duration/overage details in raw evidence. CPU/RAM allocation not documented.
No invented browser vCPU or memory allocation: normalized 4/8 rate remains null. Proxy traffic is not necessarily equivalent to sandbox egress.
Free includes 10h/500MB/100 sessions; Developer 100h/2GB, Pro 500h/10GB, Scale 5000h/35GB. Numeric overage rate not on captured page; plans say contact us.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Re-checked 2026-09-28 at https://tilion.com/pricing: plans Free $0 (3 concurrent, 10 browser h, 500 MB egress, stops at allowance), Developer $19.99 (15, 100 h, 2 GB), Pro $99.99 (50, 500 h, 10 GB), Scale $499 (200, 5,000 h, 35 GB), Enterprise custom. Overage is "billed per hour" but no numeric overage rate is published, and no CPU/RAM per session: still unpriceable beyond the included hours.

fleet.tiers: Free 3; Developer 15; Pro 50; Scale 200; Enterprise 250+ custom.
fleet.notes: Every pricing-tier CTA is 'Contact us' (mailto team@tilion.dev, subject 'Tilion access'), yet the 2026-08-07 blog says 'No waitlist, no sales call' and dashboard.tilion.dev offers 'Create an account'. Concurrency: Free 3, Developer 15, Pro 50, Scale 200, Enterprise 250+. Verification/activation time unknown.
